page.overview:
Who is Ishigo Shitemanna?

Ishigo Shitemanna is an appraiser in Water 7.

Shitemanna is a pale man with short black hair and a large, pointed mustache. He wears a white shirt with purple overalls.

Shitemanna is both unscrupulous enough to short-change new customers, and cowardly enough to immediately yield when threatened. However, he does appear to be a genuinely competent appraiser of valuables.

When Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp brought him their Skypiean gold to exchange for cash, he quickly grew excited at its sheer quality, but deliberately undervalued it at 100,000,000. Though Luffy and Usopp were easily satisfied, Nami was suspicious of the appraisal, and warned Ishigo of Luffy's bounty before threatening violence. Ishigo was instantly intimidated and exchanged their gold for its rightful cash value: 300,000,000.
